research_basis.primary_hypothesis: Interleaving parameter-unshared bidirectional cross-attention after every intra-chain block improves partner-specific interaction only when routing is controlled by pair interaction evidence rather than additive unary propensities.
literature: EpiFormer arXiv:2606.04154 motivates interleaved bidirectional information flow.
AsEP NeurIPS 2024 motivates antibody-specific bipartite evaluation and epitope-group generalization.
research_basis.novel_factor: Predicted interaction-only contact log-probability is an explicit communication bottleneck; unaligned monomer vector coordinates are never mixed across chains.

factorized_comparisons.M2_vs_M1: late fusion versus every-layer ordinary bidirectional cross-attention with the binary pair head, gated residue head and noisy-OR pooling held fixed
factorized_comparisons.M3_vs_M2: full contact-logit routing versus ordinary cross-attention
factorized_comparisons.M4_vs_M3: interaction-only routing versus routing that includes unary shortcuts
factorized_comparisons.M5_vs_M4: strict mean-probability contact marginal versus a free gated residue head; this is the pre-registered aggregation change
factorized_comparisons.M6a_vs_M5: shared-factor auxiliary distogram without consistency versus direct contact only
factorized_comparisons.M6_vs_M6a: JS agreement regularization versus the otherwise identical joint direct-contact and distogram model
factorized_comparisons.M6_vs_M7: direct contact primary versus distance-derived contact under matched interleaved routing

data.split: frozen antigen-fold v3 train and validation roles only
data.cross_chain_input_geometry: none; monomer scalar embeddings and intra-chain invariant geometry only
data.bound_distance_policy: authenticated bound distances are supervision only for M6/M7 and are never model inputs

model_selection.checkpoint_rule: maximize the minimum validation cluster-weighted reciprocal interaction-only margin; break ties within 0.0001 by mean per-complex contact AUPRC, then earlier epoch
model_selection.threshold_rule: one global threshold fitted on validation only; never per-complex and never on test

training_objective.contact: per-complex observed-class-balanced BCE on authenticated direct or distance-derived contact logits
training_objective.marginals: per-complex observed-class-balanced epitope and paratope BCE
training_objective.specificity: reciprocal wrong-partner ranking; shuffled pairs are never fabricated binary nonbinders
training_objective.wrong_pair_rule: counterfactual ranking and retrieval only; no all-zero pair label

required_epoch_metrics: pair contact macro and pooled AUPRC, precision, recall, F1, MCC and predicted-positive ratio at raw 0.5
epitope and paratope complex-macro AUPRC, precision, recall, F1 and MCC
P@10, P@Lmin/10, P@Lmin/5 and paired Recall@K
reciprocal partner margin, Recall@1 and MRR
per-layer contact entropy, attention entropy, learned contact scale, residual gate and curriculum multiplier
pooled Brier, ECE and calibration slope
promotion_rule: No promotion unless at least 3/5 seeds improve the pre-registered endpoint-disjoint primary metric, paired cluster-bootstrap 95% CI excludes zero, precision and recall do not collapse, and reciprocal partner specificity exceeds the late/unary baseline.
claim_boundary: Development-only architecture experiment. No frozen-test, external-generalization, benchmark-improvement or state-of-the-art claim is authorized.
